junro.title: Prioritree CI — the continuous-integration surface: the floor in GitHub Actions (test/lint/typecheck), the CodeQL scanning config owned by the tree, the ruff phase-2 enforcement landed where the hook deferred it — the FREE-TIER law (nothing paid on the platform), the PyPI precondition's named remainder closed; the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: THE COLLABORATOR'S CONVENING (2026-11-23): the CI effort convenes now — only for things that are FREE on GitHub (nothing paid on the platform); the inward-first direction ruled (the auth write-exposure cure and the order-bias probe after CI, outward/PyPI after inward); the >100-item scale fence held (no list in the current mindset — adaptive scheduling stays banked until the real earn)

THE AUTH REFRAME (Q-auth-widening at the birth store, ruled 2026-11-23): auth is the WRITE-EXPOSURE CURE (a reachable server is a writable filesystem), re-ranked to the inward priority class — the API-key infrastructure the design's leading candidate; the inward lane after CI: auth first, the order-bias probe after

the CodeQL event's lesson (FR-MEM-0033): GitHub's scanning already live at the default setup — the tree should own its config rather than inherit it; the first finding triaged false-positive at HEAD, the standing triage form recorded

the PyPI precondition's remainder: the LICENSE cured (MIT), the packaging cured (web + MCP in the wheel) — CI the named remainder; the hook's ruff phase 2 (.githooks/pre-commit: pyright only, ruff 'PHASE 2 (named, pending)') — the enforcement landing where the hook deferred it
the standing laws carried: the seat-authored report (R6/R11), the per-step dispatch (R8, the file-unit), the two-lane form, the ThreePart, the census-first composition
the floor at HEAD: 203 passed, zero findings, zero ignores; the five forms whole

structure.purpose: THE CI PIPELINE (the standing form): THE CENSUS FIRST — FOUR ungated legs (tansa's actions-free-forms: the runner's free class, the workflow-native uv, the workflow grammar; shindan's current-state: no .github/ at HEAD, the CodeQL default live, the hook's phase-2 state; rikai's mechanism: the workflow's construction forms, the store home's fate at the runner; keisan's pricing: the free-tier arithmetic — the floor's runtime vs the free minutes, the CodeQL limits); then THE DESIGN LANE — ungated (suisen's workflow recommendation, hyoka's adversarial pass, MOHO'S COLD-CLONE WALK: the fresh-clone story the workflow serves); then togo's gated synthesis closing G-CI-DESIGN-BRIEF; the build units' discovery legs + gated briefs precede their builds.
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green (the composition validated at the route's head); the census fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.

structure.purpose: THE CI SURFACE'S BUILD — the units the census and design earn (the likely set, named not pinned: ci-workflow — the floor in Actions + the CodeQL config owned + the hook's note amendment via the generator's source), one file per dispatch (R8's file-unit law), each landing per its approved spec (the exact-task law), kensho's independent verification per build gate, one-commit-per-increment; the free-tier law held at every step; the Makefile's targets the entrypoints; the store home CWD-relative at the runner.
structure.entry_condition: G-CI-DESIGN-BRIEF is green — the design is the spec; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law).

structure.purpose: THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form): hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry; the next era named — the inward direction: auth first, the probe second, outward after inward), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.
structure.entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.

conditions: the composition lands at the store's reports home (reports/compose/route.md — keikaku's own report, the composition whole: stages, gates, increments, the ungated placements, the load-bearing decisions) — the opening whole, the census placed FIRST with none of its findings assumed, every seat placed (R3: no seat bypassed)

every choice cites its ruling: Q-ci-surface's three (the free-tier law R1; the configurability carry + the ruff landing + the CodeQL config owned R2; the governance form + the inward direction R3) + the standing laws carried
the collaborator validates the composition — the gate is the validation; the outcome records against compose/route; no route dispatch fires before it is green

THE DESIGN BRIEF LANDED: togo's synthesis over the census (actions-free-forms, current-state, mechanism, pricing) + the design lane (workflow, adversarial, the cold-clone walk); the free-tier law held whole (nothing paid: the runner class, the CodeQL free form, the arithmetic verified); a divergence that survives reconciliation blocks the brief, never rides silently

the brief carries the design-work whole the rulings leave open: the workflow's shape (the floor job's steps — checkout, uv, the Makefile's targets as entrypoints per R2; the CodeQL job's config form owned by the tree), the ruff-phase-2 landing (the hook's note amendment riding the generator's source — hikari -> regen, never a hand-edit; CI the enforcement's home), the store home CWD-relative at the runner, the one-unit-vs-split ruling, the pricing verdict (the free minutes' arithmetic)
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the design judged ready-to-build; the build units' briefs cite it; their dispatches fire only after
hansei's retro landed: the debrief over the effort whole, the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named

the effort's records landed: the CONTINUATION entry (the landing state named honestly); the next era named (the inward direction: auth first — the write-exposure cure — then the order-bias probe, outward after inward; per R3)
the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn; the route's status set done at the ruling

the exact-task spec landed — the bytes whole over the approved design: the workflow's YAML (the floor job's steps + the CodeQL job's chain + the triggers per the no-PR law + the concurrency form), the codeql-config.yml (the positive paths), the hook's amendment source bytes, the README's lines (:189/:185/:57 + the direct-push story), the per-file dispatch plan
the free-tier law held at every byte (nothing paid; the schedule guard dropped per the synthesis's ruling; the flip leg named as the gate's blocking condition)
the collaborator approves — the build fires only after

the ci-workflow unit lands per the approved spec — the exact-task law: the workflow's YAML whole (the floor job's steps with the Makefile's targets as entrypoints; the CodeQL job's chain with the owned config; the triggers push[main] + the weekly cron alone per the no-PR law; the concurrency form with the guard dropped), the codeql-config.yml (paths: [src/, tests/]), the README's lines (:189 CI live; :185 the remainder closed; :57 the 203 drift folded; the direct-push story)

the ruff-phase-2 landing whole: the hook's amendment at the hikari source (the collaborator's hand — the source edit, the regen, the emission landing here, kensho verifying the bytes); the workflow's lint step the enforcement's home
THE FLIP LEG ATTESTED (blocking): the collaborator attests the GitHub-side default-setup flip same-turn — the default disabled at their hand, the advanced config the owner

the first live run green at the collaborator's read-back (the landing push fires the workflow — the floor + the CodeQL jobs green at GitHub's own surface); kensho's independent verification green (validate/ci-workflow)

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit ci-workflow LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/ci-workflow) + mechanism analysis (understand/ci-workflow) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the brief judged ready-to-build; the unit's dispatches fire only after
